corrected_design_controls.control: Containment reduces Disaffection by 25 once. Fully settled incidents recover 5 every 10 days without unresolved-crisis pressure.
Immediate local discharge requires no spendable payment, releases actual consenting forces and protects personnel for 180 days.
Exactly one country update occurs per 10-day review. Adverse conditions count once and relief covers all unresolved cohorts sharing its grievance.
One 180-day settlement-history window includes 90 days of ordinary-draw protection.
Unmet command concessions qualify for the negotiation bonus. Complete direct remedies receive 50 additional willingness points. Paid delivery and confirmed imminent settlement have stated priorities.
The release bonus requires adequate defense. Immediate defense takes priority over elective release of the last defending formation during invasion.

Spread obeys deadline, Disaffection, prospective cohort cap and one-use breach gates. Opposing choices use respondent confidence. Recovery admits containment and release. Schedule and protection clocks are distinct. Amnesty does not reopen the gross loss ceiling.

white_peace_scenarios.heading: 009 White Peace: settle the right war
white_peace_scenarios.pool_definition: Exactly four artificial pair candidates named pair_A through pair_D. All other candidates are absent by construction. Base scores are 40, 30, 20 and 10 except in the explicitly named zero-score cases.
white_peace_scenarios.external_factors: All unrelated score factors are fixed at neutral values. No native rounding or undisclosed Event 009 transform is assumed.
white_peace_scenarios.adapter_rule: Only an existing positive, eligible pair score can be multiplied. Apply exactly the strongest relevant multiplier to pair_A, once. Other pair scores remain unchanged.
white_peace_scenarios.normalization_rule: For this artificial proportional pool, share_i = effective_score_i / sum(effective_scores). A zero total has no normalized selection share.

WP01.context: One side has a relevant major mutiny

WP02.context: Both sides have relevant major mutinies

WP03.context: Both sides have major mutinies and a sustained valid reciprocal front compact

WP04.context: Pair A has a zero existing score but passes structural eligibility. Each authored multiplier is tried separately. The other three pairs are unchanged.

WP05.context: Pair A has base score 40 but fails an existing Event 009 eligibility gate. Each authored multiplier is tried separately. The other three pairs are unchanged.

WP06.context: All three nested context descriptions apply. Only the strongest row is used.

WP07.context: All four pairs have zero existing scores. No multiplier creates a positive candidate.
WP07.owner_result: Event 009 retains authority over an empty pool. Event 120 creates no replacement candidate or peace.
